title: Right-now summaries silently make paid LLM calls on every create/update/comment (and for every ancestor), with cost logged as $0
description:
## Summary

With `right_now` enabled (the documented default), **every `kbs create`, `update` and `comment` makes paid LLM calls** (LiteLLM -> OpenAI `gpt-5.6-luna`) for the issue **and for each of its ancestors**, using the `OPENAI_API_KEY` that Kanbus silently loads from the repository `.env`. The calls are not announced, are not opt-in per command, and are costed as $0 in both `llm_usage.jsonl` and `kbs cost`, so the spend is invisible. Some generated summaries were also unfaithful to the issue text.

## Observed (two real repos, one agent session, 2026-10-01)

- Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations: 268 `right_now_summary` calls (about 196k prompt + 19k completion tokens); Decision-Flywheel: 90 calls (about 295k tokens in all across the two repos). All from one coding-agent session that filed ~35 issues and ~40 comments/updates with `kbs`.
- `project/events/llm_usage.jsonl` records every call, with `"cost": 0.0` for each (the response cost for the unknown model name `gpt-5.6-luna` is reported as 0.0), and `kbs cost` reports `$0.0000`. Real spend is unknowable from Kanbus.
- The agent never read or exported the key. Kanbus loaded it itself (`load_repository_environment(root)` in `python/src/kanbus/right_now.py`).
- One generated summary for a newly created planning initiative said "The team is running live rounds..." although nothing was running (a plan had only just been filed). Summaries were later wiped with `kbs now --purge`; the raw text is gone, so this is second-hand and not independently reproduced.

## Why it multiplies

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  A["kbs create / update / comment"] --> B["regenerate_right_now = True (default)"]
  B --> C["regenerate_right_now_for_issue_and_ancestors"]
  C --> D["LLM call for the issue"]
  D --> E["LLM call for its parent"]
  E --> F["...one call per ancestor up to the initiative"]
```

`issue_comment.py` and `issue_update.py` default `regenerate_right_now=True`; `regenerate_right_now_for_issue_and_ancestors` (right_now.py) loops up the parent chain, one LLM call per level. Deep trees and bulk agent edits therefore cost a multiple of the number of commands.

## Steps to reproduce

1. In a Kanbus repo whose `.kanbus.yml` has `ai.provider: litellm` and `right_now.enabled: true` (or no `enabled` key, which defaults to true per CONFIGURATION.md), with `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the repo's gitignored `.env`.
2. Note the call count: `wc -l project/events/llm_usage.jsonl` (file may not exist yet).
3. Create a 3-level hierarchy: `kbs create "I" --type initiative`, then `kbs create "E" --type epic --parent <I>`, then `kbs create "T" --type task --parent <E>`.
4. Run `kbs comment <T> "hello"`.
5. Re-run `wc -l project/events/llm_usage.jsonl` and inspect the new lines (`operation: right_now_summary`, `issue_id`). Expect several new entries, including for the epic and the initiative, from one comment.
6. Run `kbs cost` and observe `$0.0000` while tokens were consumed.
7. Set `right_now.enabled: false` and repeat steps 4 to 5: no new entries.

Note: I did not re-run these steps to avoid more paid calls; they are derived from the observed behaviour above and from reading right_now.py, issue_comment.py and issue_update.py.

## Expected behaviour

- No network LLM calls from board-mutating commands unless the user explicitly opted in (default `right_now.enabled: false`, or a per-command flag).
- A clear one-line notice when a command makes an LLM call, or a dry-run/confirm mode.
- Cost reporting that never shows $0 for real calls: fall back to an estimate or show tokens prominently when the model's price is unknown.
- Do not regenerate every ancestor on each write; debounce, batch, or regenerate lazily when a summary is displayed.
- Do not load credentials from `.env` for a feature the user did not explicitly enable; document which key is used.
- Summaries should be grounded in issue text only (consider a stricter prompt or a faithfulness check so planning-only issues are not described as active work).

## Workaround

`right_now:
  enabled: false` in `.kanbus.yml`.

comments.text: Fixed in AnthusAI/Kanbus#381 (merged to develop): create/update/comment/dep/delete no longer make LLM calls; summaries are generated lazily by kbs now / console Now / standup, and a parent refreshes when a direct child changed after its summary. Unpriced calls log cost null and kbs cost reports Unpriced Calls. Promotion to main: AnthusAI/Kanbus#395.

right_now_summary: Paid LLM calls happen silently on writes and ancestors, while cost reporting shows zero.
